h1: The 6 Best Countertop Dishwashers Under $500 of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six countertop dishwashers under $500, covering no-hookup tanks, place settings, wash programs, noise and Energy Star status.
summary: The COMFEE' 1.32-gallon tank model is the pick for renters who cannot plumb anything in, with a 162 degree wash and air-dry. The COMFEE' 8-program Energy Star model suits households that want options, and the EUHOMY 360 degree unit is the quiet choice at 40dB. The NOVETE fits parents who want a baby-care cycle.
intro: A countertop dishwasher looks like the perfect fix for an apartment kitchen until you discover it needs a faucet adapter, a drain hose and a free stretch of counter. The first question is not capacity, it is how the water gets in.

We reviewed six models and ranked them on paper by hookup method, place settings, wash programs, noise and efficiency labels. Everything here lands in the $200-500 bucket, and we kept to what the titles and specs claim.

products.name: COMFEE' Portable Mini Dishwasher Countertop with 1.32Gal Built-in Water Tank for Apartments & RVs, No Hookup Needed, 6 Programs, 360° Dual Spray, 162℉ High-Temp & Air-Dry Function
products.verdict: No plumbing, a hot wash and an air-dry cycle.
products.description:
This COMFEE' has a 1.32-gallon built-in tank so no plumbing hookup is needed, six wash programs, dual 360 degree spray arms and a 162 degree high-temp cycle with air-dry. It is in the $200-500 bucket.

The tank COMFEE' wins out as the tank removes the biggest barrier for renters, and the hot wash plus air-dry covers the finishing step the 40dB EUHOMY below lacks on paper.

It suits apartments, RVs and anyone without a drain. You fill the tank by hand each cycle.

products.name: COMFEE' Countertop Dishwasher, Energy Star Portable Dishwasher, 6 Place Settings & 8 Washing Programs, Speed, Baby-Care, ECO & Glass, Dish Washer for Dorm, RV & Apartment, Black
products.verdict: Eight wash programs and Energy Star certification.
products.description:
This COMFEE' offers six place settings, eight programs including Speed, Baby-Care, ECO and Glass, Energy Star certification and a black finish. It is in the $200-500 bucket.

The eight-program COMFEE' comes second as its program range is the widest here, but the listing does not describe a built-in tank, so it likely needs a faucet connection. That is the trade against the first pick.

Choose it for a dorm or apartment with a sink faucet that accepts an adapter.
products.idealFor: Dorms and apartments with a faucet.
products.skipIf: You cannot connect to a faucet.

products.name: EUHOMY 6 Programs Countertop Dishwasher Portable, 40dB, 360° Coverage
products.verdict: Rated at 40dB for kitchens close to living spaces.
products.description:
The EUHOMY has six wash programs, a 40dB rated noise level, 360 degree spray coverage and a countertop no-hookup design. It sits in the $200-500 bucket.

The EUHOMY takes bronze as the quiet rating is the point, but it does not list the hot wash or air-dry features that the top COMFEE' does.

Best for open-plan studios where the dishwasher runs near the couch.
products.skipIf: You want a hot sanitizing wash.

products.name: NOVETE Portable Countertop Dishwashers, Compact Dishwashers with 5L Built-in Water Tank & Inlet Hose, 5 Washing Programs, Baby Care, Air-Dry Function and LED Light for Small Apartments
products.verdict: Tank or hose, with a dedicated baby-care cycle.
products.description:
The NOVETE has a 5L built-in tank with an optional inlet hose hookup, five wash programs including Baby Care, an air-dry function and an LED indicator light. It is in the $200-500 bucket.

The NOVETE sits fourth as the tank-or-hose flexibility is useful, but five programs is the fewest in this ranking and 5L is a smaller tank than the 1.32-gallon COMFEE' above.

It suits parents sterilizing bottles. Expect to refill often if you use the tank.

products.name: AIRMSEN Large Slim Countertop Dishwasher | Built-in Water Tank
products.verdict: More interior space in a narrower footprint.
products.description:
The AIRMSEN Large Slim has a built-in water tank and a body that promises a bigger interior in a narrower footprint, in the $200-500 bucket.

The Large Slim AIRMSEN lands fifth as its listing gives no program count, noise or place-setting figure, so its capacity advantage is unquantified, unlike the COMFEE' models above.

Choose it if counter width is the constraint. Confirm exact capacity on the product page first.

products.name: AIRMSEN Portable Countertop Dishwasher, No Hookup Needed
products.verdict: A basic no-hookup unit with little detail in the listing.
products.description:
This AIRMSEN is a no-hookup, built-in tank countertop portable model, in the $200-500 bucket.

The basic AIRMSEN trails the group as its listing lists no wash programs, noise level or capacity, while the COMFEE' and EUHOMY models above all document theirs.

It suits buyers who want to keep it simple. Compare the product page against rivals before purchase.

whatMatters.detail: A built-in tank means you pour water in by hand, while a hose model attaches to your faucet. Tanks suit renters but need refilling. Check the title for tank volume or inlet hose.
Six place settings is about a day of dishes for one or two people. Bigger households need to run it twice. Look for the number, and check what a place setting includes.
A high-temp cycle of 162 degrees Fahrenheit helps break down grease and sanitize. Not every model lists one. Look for temperature in the spec bullets.
A 40dB rating is roughly library-quiet, important in studios. Many listings omit it. Search for dB in the title or bullets.
These units occupy a large block of counter. Measure width, depth and the door clearance. Compare the product dimensions to your space.

faq.a: Some use a built-in tank you fill by hand. Others connect to a faucet.
Ignoring counter space. Measure the unit and door clearance first.
It signals lower water and power use per cycle, which helps if you run it often.

faq.q: How do I set up a tank model?
faq.a: Fill the tank, load dishes, choose a program and run.
Clean the filter regularly and run a cleaning cycle to avoid odor.
Large pots often do not fit six place settings. Hand wash them.

finalTake: The COMFEE' 1.32-gallon no-hookup model is the best fit for most renters because it needs no plumbing and washes hot. Quiet-minded buyers should pick the EUHOMY, and parents the NOVETE. Settle on the water setup first.
